rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an inclined surface or an area of ground that rises or falls.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 ce4 po1 hou2 sin3

rows.note: Use this for how steep a surface is, including the pitch of a roof when the roof context is clear.

example.english: The slope of this roof is too steep, so it leaks when it rains.
example.traditional: 呢個屋頂斜度太大，落雨會漏水。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 uk1 deng2 ce4 dou6 taai3 daai6 lok6 jyu5 wui5 lau6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this technical mathematical term for the gradient of a line.

example.english: The slope of this straight line is negative two.
example.traditional: 呢條直線嘅斜率係負二。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zik6 sin3 ge3 ce4 leot6 hai6 fu6 ji6
